name: yellout
description: YellOut / YellZone — anonymous voice venting sanctuary

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web & wait
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace=@yellout/shared && npm run dev --workspace=@yellout/api
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build --workspace=@yellout/shared && npm run start --workspace=@yellout/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@yellout/shared && npm run build --workspace=@yellout/api && npm run build --workspace=@yellout/web
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:mobile && npm run test:e2e
